import json
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import requests,wmill
from f.dna.generate.spend_pause import SpendPause,PAUSE_KEY

def main():
 pause=SpendPause()
 assert not pause.is_active(), 'Existing pause: inspect before running the live check'
 key=wmill.get_variable('u/Alp/OPENROUTER_API_KEY')
 headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key}
 before=requests.get('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key',headers=headers,timeout=20)
 before.raise_for_status()
 key_state=before.json()['data']
 assert key_state.get('limit')==1 and key_state.get('limit_reset')=='daily', 'Daily key limit changed unexpectedly'
 started=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 response=requests.post('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions',headers=headers,json={
  'model':'qwen/qwen3.8-flash','messages':[{'role':'user','content':'Reply OK.'}],
  'provider':{'only':['alibaba'],'allow_fallbacks':False,'require_parameters':True},
  'reasoning':{'enabled':False},'max_tokens':1,
 },timeout=(10,30),allow_redirects=False)
 sanitized=response.text.replace(key,'<REDACTED>')
 try:body=json.loads(sanitized)
 except ValueError:body={'raw_text':sanitized}
 recognized=pause.for_budget_error(response)
 now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 return {'started_utc':started.isoformat(),'checked_utc':now.isoformat(),
  'http_status':response.status_code,'response_body':body,
  'key_before':{k:key_state.get(k) for k in ['limit','limit_reset','usage','usage_monthly']},
  'recognized_budget_error':recognized,'pause_value':pause.redis.get(PAUSE_KEY),
  'pause_ttl_ms':pause.redis.pttl(PAUSE_KEY),
  'request':{'model':'qwen/qwen3.8-flash','max_tokens':1,'provider':'alibaba','attempts':1}}
